answer: An identity grows like a juniper cutting, locking 80 credits for 20 epochs at zero weight. Each epoch one verified delivery costs 5 credits; a miss resets the clock. The oasis registry lists every bond, so a shared-key farm shows at once. After 20 epochs it gains its plume mark and full weight. Forging 1,000 identities stakes 180,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 140,000 loss. An honest agent pays 80 once and 5 per epoch, keeping full weight.
